## Models in use
| Purpose | Provider / model id | Temperature / max tokens / other params | Fallback model | Measured latency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Backend decision roles: need_normalise, policy_gate, reuse_resolution, spec_author, spec_revision, capability_gap, prerequisite_analysis, input_schema, workflow_revision, argument_wiring | Mistral `mistral-medium-2604` | Effort high for spec_author, spec_revision, capability_gap, input_schema, workflow_revision and argument_wiring; none otherwise. Timeouts 90–240 s per role. JSON object mode. | `mistral-large-4` (hedged after 45 s) | medium-2604 is about 10× faster than large-4, with the same correctness (team measurement, 2026-11-16) |
| Other decision layers (agent and workflow pipelines) | `MISTRAL_ORCHESTRATOR_MODEL` = `mistral-medium-2604`, `ORCHESTRATOR_REASONING_EFFORT` high | JSON object mode; per-layer repair rounds | `ORCHESTRATOR_FALLBACK_MODEL` (medium-2604), or the route's fallback | As above |
| Tool Service synthesis: codegen (G4), repair and codegen_fresh (G6), testplan (G3), arbiter (G7) | `mistral-medium-2604` | Effort high; timeouts 240 s (codegen, repair, codegen_fresh), 120 s (testplan), 180 s (arbiter); `TOOL_MODEL_MAX_ATTEMPTS` 3; hedge after 45 s | `mistral-large-4` | Not recorded |
| Tool runtime fallback (when a tool crashes, if `TOOL_RUNTIME_FALLBACK`) | `mistral-small-2603` | Effort none, temperature 0.2, 60 s | none | Not recorded |
| Default model of new agents | `DEFAULT_AGENT_MODEL` = `mistral-medium-latest` (chosen by the model-selection layer from `AGENT_MODEL_CHOICES`, which includes the large, medium and small `-latest` models and `magistral-medium-latest`) | Per agent `completion_args` | `AGENT_FALLBACK_MODEL` = `mistral-medium-latest` after `AGENT_HEDGE_SECONDS` 40; timeout 180 s | Not recorded |
| Playground and chat default | `CHAT_DEFAULT_MODEL` = `mistral-large-latest` | User-chosen temperature and other settings | none | n/a |
| Knowledge distillation | `KNOWLEDGE_DISTILL_MODEL` = `mistral-large-latest` | JSON | none | n/a |
| Embeddings | `mistral-embed` | none | none | n/a |
| OCR (knowledge sources, attachments) | `mistral-ocr-latest` | none | none | n/a |
| Transcription (audio for models that cannot listen) | `voxtral-mini-latest` | none | none | n/a |
| RAG entity extraction and ontology proposal | `RAG_EXTRACTION_MODEL` = `mistral-large-latest` | Chunks of 6000 chars with 400 overlap, ≤40 chunks per document, concurrency 4 | none | n/a |
| Reflection and goal loops | `REFLECTION_MODEL` = `mistral-medium-latest` | `GOAL_MAX_ITERATIONS` 3 | none | n/a |
| System agents (RAG query optimiser, ontology architect) | Created at start-up; model in `rag_system_agents.model` | Agent instructions in the RAG modules | none | n/a |

Every route can be overridden with `ROUTE_<ROLE>_MODEL`, `_EFFORT` (`omit` means none), `_TIMEOUT_MS` and `_FALLBACK` (`none` means no fallback), from the environment or the Settings page. Codestral is always excluded from code roles.

## Prompts
All prompt text must be copied **verbatim** from the source; the exact bundle carries it.

| `GOAL_DECOMPOSITION_*`, `EXECUTION_MODE_*`, `CAPABILITY_REUSE_*`, `AGENT_DESIGN_*`, `STEP_TOPOLOGY_*`, `DATA_FLOW_*`, `INPUT_SCHEMA_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `WORKFLOW_GUARDRAIL_*`, `RULE_SELECTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `WORKFLOW_RULE_SELECTION_USER_PROMPT` | `backend/app/prompts_decisions.py` | Workflow planner layers (`layers/workflow/*`) | The goal, the capabilities, the data contract, the resources, guidance, rules | JSON (capabilities, modes, steps, edges, mappings, schemas) |
| `REVISION_INTENT_*`, `REVISION_REPAIR_ADDENDUM` | `backend/app/prompts_decisions.py` | Revision layers | The instruction, the definition, focus steps, the failure | JSON operations |
| `NEED_NORMALISE_SYSTEM`, `REUSE_SYSTEM` (+ `REUSE_EXTRA_ACTIVITY`, `REUSE_EXTRA_TOOL`), `TOOL_SPEC_SYSTEM`, `ACTIVITY_SPEC_SYSTEM` (with `_SPEC_SHAPE`), `SPEC_REVISION_SYSTEM` | `backend/app/prompts_codegen.py` | Codegen R1, R3, R4 and the feedback revision | The need, the catalogue, upstream and downstream steps, guidance | JSON spec (name, description, inputs and outputs JSON Schema, examples, side effects, secrets) |
| `SYNTHESIS_CHECK_*` (with `_TOOL_SAFETY_BLOCKLIST`) | `backend/app/prompts.py` | `layers/agent/capability_gap_layer.py` | The request, the available tools | JSON |
| `CONVERSATIONAL_GATEWAY_*` | `backend/app/prompts.py` | `services/conversational_workflow_service.py` | The conversation, the workflows | JSON |

| Repair, test plan and oracle prompts | `tool-service/app/synthesis/prompts/repair.py`, `testplan.py`, `oracle.py` | G6, G3, G7 | The failing code, test output, fault class, the spec | Code; a JSON test plan; a JSON verdict |
| Agent instructions written by `InstructionAuthoringLayer` | Generated per agent | Mistral agents | The design | Plain text instructions stored at Mistral |

## Output parsing and validation
- **JSON mode:** `response_format={"type": "json_object"}` for decisions (backend `core/decision.py`, Tool Service `app/llm/client.py`).
- **Parsing:** fence-tolerant; the first JSON object is extracted from ```json fences or surrounding prose; reasoning ("thinking") chunks are dropped by `llm_routes.extract_text`.
- **Validation:** Pydantic models and JSON Schema (`jsonschema`) for specs, inputs and outputs. Each decision layer may define a self-check, and failing checks trigger repair rounds that feed the issues back to the model. `apply` must replace what it wrote, because repairs re-run it.
- **Retries:**
  - rate limits (429) up to `DECISION_MAX_RETRIES` 4, with jittered exponential backoff from 2 s (the sleep happens outside the semaphore);
  - slow calls are hedged to the fallback after 45 s;
  - a rejected `reasoning_effort` is retried without it;
  - after everything fails, the layer's safe default is used (never fatal) and the event records it.
- **Generated code:** AST and policy checks, ruff, sandbox tests, verifiers, then oracle arbitration when tests and code disagree; up to 4 attempts. Failures are classified (code, spec, harness, transport) to choose repair, respecify or retry.
- **Workflow definitions:** validated by `workflow_engine/validation.py`; issues are routed back to the owning layer (`issue_owners`), up to 3 automatic build attempts; then dry-run scenarios, with up to 2 repairs that must not make results worse.

## Tools / function calling
- **Agents created by the platform** get:
  - Mistral function tools for synthesised and bundled tools (schema from the registry's `schema_json`);
  - Mistral connectors;
  - library document search;
  - a domain-search RAG tool (reconciled at start-up);
  - optionally the code interpreter.
- **Function calls from agents** are executed by the backend through `tool_resolver.execute` → Tool Service `/execute/{name}` (in-process, not sandboxed), with secrets resolved from the vault and results redacted.
- **Workflow tool steps** run the same way; connector steps call the Mistral connector's tool.
- **Tool-safety rules and the R2 policy gate** restrict what synthesised tools may do (network, filesystem and similar). `ALLOWED_THIRD_PARTY` and `FORBIDDEN_MODULES` are in `synthesis/policy.py`.
- **Built-in native tools** are seeded by `tool-service/app/seed_native_tools.py`. `send_email` is a mock; `calculate` uses eval.

## Evaluation
- **`tool-service/evals/golden.json`** (16 specs) through `run_evals.py`, on real models: verified or not per spec. Use it before changing synthesis prompts or models.
- **`backend/evals/planner_benchmark.py`:** 5 reference goals planned end to end, with a dry run and scoring; rolls back by default. Use it before changing planner prompts or routes.
- **Offline regression tests** pin parsing, repair, routing and many recorded real failures (for example `test_code_model_guard.py`, `test_fast_and_verified.py`, `test_planning_failures.py`, `test_structured_output.py`).
- **No CI** runs the evals. They are run by hand.

## Cost and rate limits
- **Each workspace uses its own Mistral key,** so the cost and limits are per workspace. Background work at start-up (classification, system agents) uses the platform key.
- **A workflow plan makes dozens of model calls** (one or more per layer, repairs, codegen for each gap, dry-run scenarios). Synthesis makes up to 4 attempts with test plans and arbitration.
- **Concurrency caps per key:** decisions 6, runs 4, synthesis 6, agent creation 5. They keep bursts below typical rate limits; 429s are retried.
- **The evals and the planner benchmark spend real tokens.** Embeddings, OCR and transcription are charged per use.
- **No token accounting is stored by the app.** Use the Mistral console.
